Body.Content:
You can now export work queue items directly from the Automation Center portal. A new option available in the Work Queues experience lets you download items as a CSV file.

This capability allows you to access work queue data in a portable format for further analysis, reporting, or integration with other tools, without needing to rely on external APIs or custom solutions.

Business Value:

This feature lets you quickly export work queue data from Automation Center into a CSV file, so you can dig deeper into analysis, create custom reports, and share insights across your teams. It helps you boost visibility, streamline collaboration, and make smarter decisions faster.

Enabled for:

Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

GA date: July CY2026
